title: The Pullman house's 18th Street trees stand where the photographs show them
items: Along 18th Street beside 1729 Prairie, five parkway trees now stand where an 1890s photograph of the house puts them: one by the corner, then a row past the porte-cochère and either side of the carriage gate. The two trees guessed there before stood between them.
A second photograph of the same corner was checked against each one.
